mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions, which directly boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases discount rates for equity cash flows and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in CPIAUCSL (above 0.3%) and FEDFUNDS (above 0.1%) indicate accelerating inflation and aggressive policy response, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise by at least 0.3% and 0.1% respectively, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom (HOUST > 1500 units), a monthly CPIAUCSL increase above 0.3% signals economic overheating and imminent central bank intervention, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% and HOUST > 1500, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals expanding manufacturing output, which directly increases corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% quarter-over-quarter, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts figure (HOUST) below 1400 units signals a contracting housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1400, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%), a monthly CPIAUCSL increase above 0.3% indicates wage-driven inflation, prompting aggressive monetary policy that reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% and industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% indicate robust consumer demand and manufacturing expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and INDPRO rise by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
